The alphabet is taken as the alphanumeric superset: the samples are base58-consistent, but three samples show what is present, not what is excluded. re_ is short and ends many identifiers (are_, pre_, score_), so the leading boundary matters; the product adds a mixed-case guard (at least one upper- and one lower-case letter in the body) as false-positive policy.
